entity.description: What an outside party may do with one record of an organization: the record (recordType and recordId, the party (a customer or supplier), its scopes (comma separated, such as InvoicePay or BillUpload), its expiry and revocation, and the digest of its bearer token. The token itself is shown once, when it is created, and never stored.

field.name: partyId
field.description: The outside party: the invoice's customer, the order's supplier.

field.name: recordType
field.description: Invoice or Order; the record types ExternalAccess.js knows.

field.name: issuerKind
field.description: organization (an internal user's link) or contact (a signed-in contact's shared link).

field.name: boundCapabilityId
field.description: An emailed code's capability (the OrderChange scope, SEC-PSS-23): the order link it was asked with, which alone may use it; its tokenDigest binds the code to that link.

field.name: failedTries
field.description: An emailed code's wrong tries; the fifth ends it.

field.name: partyId
field.description: The account's party.

field.name: app
field.description: billing or supplier (PublicApps.js).

entity.description: A DbForm offered for a purpose by an organization: its context record when the publication is of one (a campaign, an event; empty for case feedback, whose invitations carry their own), the PASS site it is answered on when it is fixed (empty: the organization's site of the app), open from fromDate to thruDate, its access (invited recipients, anyone, or signed-in accounts) and its repeat policy (once per invitation, or more).

field.name: titleText
field.description: The page's heading (empty: the form's name)

field.name: introText
field.description: Plain text above the questions; no expression

field.name: completionMessage
field.description: The receipt's words after an answer (empty: a neutral thank you)

entity.description: The registration of a purpose of the survey builder's forms (impl-people P16, F51, F62; mantle.party.FormDefinitions): a DbForm of a registered purpose is built and read through mantle.party.FormDefinitionServices (FormDefinitions.js), which check the permission that edits it (editPermission) and the one that also reads it (viewPermission), each a permission or a comma list of them any one of which admits, and the organization it is owned by: one the scope service names (scopeServiceName answers organizationPartyIds for the user; empty, the user's own internal organizations). A publication of such a form (FormPublication, its invitation links) takes only the access kinds accessEnumIds lists (a comma list of FormPublicationAccess ids); none means the form is answered only by the respondents an app's own service assigns, with no public or invitation link, its answers read through that app's service of the record they belong to. formNoun is the word the builder's messages use (template, form). Customer Service registers its case templates and case feedback, People its private purposes (impl-people P16), Marketing its own.

field.name: fieldAudienceEnumId
field.description: impl-marketing P12: the audience every field of the purpose takes (CfaCustomer for a public purpose, whose every question a visitor answers); empty: the one each field is given, internal by default

field.name: ownServices
field.description: Y: its forms are built only through its app's own services, which add the app's rules (Customer Service's case templates and case feedback: CaseTemplateServices and CaseFeedbackServices, the customer audience and the rating); FormDefinitionServices reads them and refuses to make or change one (PURPOSE_UNAVAILABLE, impl-people P16 review)

entity.description: impl-marketing P12 (design-drawers-commons §19; design-marketing §13 SubmitForm): one accepted public answer of a publication (mantle.party.FormPublicationServices accept#Submission): the response it made (formResponseId, read with the form as of submittedDate), the invitation it answered when invited, the party verified for it (an invitation's recipient or a signed-in account's own party; never one an email field names), the site, the request identity (requestKey: a digest of the page's request key, unique, so a repeat answers the first) with the digest of what was sent (payloadDigest: the same key with other answers is refused), and the state of its effects after acceptance (a subscription choice, an automation, a lead handoff), each separate and replay-safe. Its response is kept as submitted, as an invited one is (FormPublication.eecas.xml).

field.name: effectsText
field.description: What its effects did, or why one failed (no answer text)

entity.description: One recipient's invitation to answer a publication once: the recipient (partyId, the party the answer is of: a case's customer) and who it is sent to (contactPartyId, emailAddress), its context record (contextEntityName and contextId: for case feedback the case's resolution CaseSlaEpisode, else the Request) and the record that holds it (recordEntityName and recordId: the Request), the app's policy row it was made under (policyId) and the key that makes it once (invitationKey: one per case, or per resolution); when it is sent (scheduledDate), until when its link works (expireDate), its delivery (statusEnumId, the sends, reminders and the last error) and its one response (formResponseId, responseDate and the score when the form has a rating). The links are ExternalAccessCapability rows of record type FormInvitation; each send makes one that ends at expireDate.

field.name: policyId
field.description: The app's delivery policy row (case feedback: FeedbackDeliveryPolicy) the invitation was made under

entity.description: A staff invitation: an address, the organization the invited person will work for (a relationship of relationshipTypeEnumId), the grant proposal (registered bundles, checked when it is sent and again when it is accepted) and a single-use token, kept only as its hash, that lasts until expiresDate. statusId is UinvPending until it is accepted (UinvAccepted, with the account it went to) or revoked (UinvRevoked); a pending one past expiresDate reads as expired (UinvExpired). A resend gives it a new token, so the earlier one no longer matches. operationKey makes a retry of the same request answer this invitation. The token itself is mailed, or shown once to the inviter when the instance cannot send mail (linkShownDate); it is never stored, listed or logged. Read and changed only through mantle.party.IdentityServices.

field.name: emailAddress
field.description: The invited address; the account the invitation goes to has it.

field.name: firstName
field.description: The person's name when the invitation makes a new person.

field.name: partyId
field.description: An existing person the inviter chose, or the person the acceptance made or matched.

field.name: userId
field.description: The account the invitation was accepted with.

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The internal organization the person will work for; the organization entity filters apply to it.

field.name: relationshipTypeEnumId
field.description: PrtEmployee, PrtAgent or PrtMember.

field.name: bundleGroupIds
field.description: The grant proposal: registered bundles (UserGroup ids, comma separated) the app supplied, validated structured data, never executable.

field.name: message
field.description: The inviter's note in the email.

field.name: tokenHash
field.description: The hash of the current token (singleUseCodeHash); never the token.

field.name: sentDate
field.description: When the current token was issued (sent, or made for the link shown).

field.name: mailSent
field.description: Y when the current token went out by mail.

field.name: linkShownDate
field.description: When the acceptance link of the current token was shown to the inviter, the instance having no mail server; audited, without the token.

field.name: factorId
field.description: The authenticator factor the acceptance made when a bundle's group requires one, until its first code confirms it.

field.name: acceptVisitId
field.description: The session (Visit) the acceptance ran in: only it, or the account signed in, sees the factor step and its key.

field.name: operationKey
field.description: The caller's key of the request: a retry with the same key answers this invitation.

entity.description: One lifecycle request of an account: a global disable (now, or at a future date written to the account's terminateDate), the removal from one internal organization (its relationships, and the account's memberships when no organization is left), or a restoration (enabled again, no credential or schedule brought back). Its independent steps (UserLifecycleOperationStep) each keep their own outcome: a failed step leaves the others, and the revocation, in place and stays to be retried. organizationPartyId is the organization it was requested for (the one removed, or for a global operation the target's organization in the requester's scope), which the organization entity filters apply to. operationKey makes a retry of the same request answer this operation. Read and changed only through mantle.party.IdentityServices.

field.name: userId
field.description: The account the operation is about.

field.name: kindEnumId
field.description: UlkDisable, UlkOrgRemoval, UlkRestore, or UlkProvision (a People hire's provisioning, request#Provisioning: userId empty until the person has an account).

field.name: isGlobal
field.description: Y for an account-wide operation (disable, restore), N for one organization's removal.

field.name: effectiveDate
field.description: When it takes effect; a future date of a disable is the account's terminateDate, of a removal the relationships' end.

field.name: sourceReference
field.description: The requesting record, as its owner names it (People's operation key, later); empty for Admin's own requests.

field.name: statusId
field.description: UlopCompleted, UlopScheduled (taking effect at its date) or UlopAttention (a step failed or waits for an owner).

field.name: accountRevision
field.description: The account revision the request named.

entity.description: One independent step of a lifecycle operation: the account's own (disable, end date, access revoked, relationships and memberships ended, enabled again) or a participant's (an owner's pause, or a resource waiting for a new owner through the owner's transfer service, design-admin §14). It keeps the target identity, the provider and its action, the state, the attempts and the reason; never a copy of the owner's records or a secret. A participant step names only a service carrying the owned-resource contract (org.moqui.admin.IdentityServices define#OwnedResourceTransfer or define#OwnedResourcePause).

field.name: stepKind
field.description: disableAccount, endDate, revokeAccess, endRelationships, endMemberships, enableAccount, pause or transfer; a provisioning's membership, invite, grants and notify.

field.name: providerKey
field.description: identity for the account's own steps, else the participant's key (the app's registration).

field.name: actionService
field.description: A participant step's service (the owner's pause or transfer).

field.name: resourceParameter
field.description: The owner's name for the resource's id among the transfer service's parameters.

field.name: toUserId
field.description: The new owner a transfer went to.

field.name: statusId
field.description: UlstDone, UlstFailed, UlstWaiting (for a new owner) or UlstSkipped.

entity.description: One message to one recipient for one event: the event (its source's key, such as shopDownloads:ORDER), the recipient (a party and the address it went to), the channel and template key, the consent snapshot (transactional, or the marketing consent state when it was handed off), the state (MessageDeliveryState: queued, sent, retry, failed, suppressed, uncertain), the attempts with the next one's time, the provider's message id and the last safe error. The event, recipient, channel and template key are unique, so a retry or a second source call never sends twice.

field.name: templateKey
field.description: The EmailTemplate (emailTemplateId) for the email channel.

field.name: organizationPartyId
sendingProfileId
field.description: The sending profile it goes out from (impl-marketing P6, F13): its relay, sender and reply-to, within its throttle and quiet hours, with the bounce address bounces+(deliveryId).(bounceKey)@ its bounce domain; empty: as the template says.

field.name: bounceKey
field.description: The random key of its VERP bounce address, bounces+(deliveryId).(bounceKey)@ the profile's bounce domain (P6 review): anyone can mail the bounce address, so the intake takes a report for this delivery only with this key, never by the delivery id alone.

field.name: receiptEnumId
field.description: The strongest later fact of the delivery (MessageDeliveryReceipt, P6, F14): delivered, soft bounce, hard bounce or complaint; apart from the hand-off's state, and never moved back by a weaker one.

field.name: parametersJson
field.description: The template's body parameters as handed off, without secrets kept elsewhere (a link's token is put in only for the send and never stored).

field.name: transactional
field.description: Y for a notice of the recipient's own purchase or account, which needs no marketing consent.

field.name: consentJson
field.description: The consent snapshot taken before the hand-off.

entity.description: One hand-off of a delivery to its channel: when, the outcome (sent, retryable, permanent, uncertain, suppressed), the provider's message id and the safe error. History only.

A block on one destination of a channel (an email address, normalized: trimmed and in lower case), for every organization (organizationPartyId empty) or one, by its reason (a hard bounce, a complaint, staff, repeated soft failures) and source (a provider callback, a delivery status or abuse report, staff entry), with the evidence, from and thru dates, who added it and who ended it with what evidence. Rows are history: an end sets thruDate and the reviewer's evidence; nothing is deleted.

field.name: channelEnumId
field.description: MessageDeliveryChannel (MdcEmail)

field.name: destinationKey
field.description: The normalized destination (an email address trimmed and in lower case)

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: Empty: every organization (a provider-level block)

field.name: sourceRef
field.description: The source event: a delivery, a report's message id

entity.description: A reusable message of an organization: its name, channel (MessageDeliveryChannel), purpose (MessageTemplatePurpose: promotional or transactional, different kinds of one library, not delivery permissions), locale, its EmailTemplate for email (made with it), and from and thru dates: a template ended is no longer offered; its contents stay.

One dated content of a template: its subject and preheader, the body as a dbresource:// file named .html.fancy-locked and the text alternative as a .fancy-locked file (F78: the locked renderer renders by location with an explicit map, so each store writes a file of its own), and the variables it may name with each one's label, fallback and whether it is required (variablesJson). A draft has no fromDate; a published content has the date it takes effect and is never changed; the next published content ends it (thruDate). Who wrote and who published it, with the publication's reason.

A sending profile of an organization: its name, channel, the relay it sends through (emailServerId: an EmailServer no mail account owns), the sender (fromAddress, fromName) and reply-to, its purpose (MessageTemplatePurpose; empty: both), a throttle (at most so many messages an hour), quiet hours (from and to as HH:mm in its time zone, when nothing is sent), its tracking policy (MessageTrackingPolicy), the bounce domain of its VERP addresses (bounces+(delivery)@ the domain, received by the hosted account bounces@ the domain), the PASS site whose Account page takes its unsubscribes, and dates; with its last readiness check.

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Links and opens of recipients who allow tracking

entity.description: One later fact of a delivery, once per kind (MessageDeliveryReceipt: delivered, soft bounce, hard bounce, complaint): when, the report it came from and its safe detail (a status code and the remote server's diagnostic).

One message the bounce intake read: the EmailMessage (a report a bounce account received, or a sent message the edge relay marked bounced), its kind (MessageDeliveryReportKind: DSN, ARF, the edge's bounce), the delivery its key found, the fact it recorded, its outcome (MessageDeliveryReportStatus: applied, no change, unknown key, unreadable, ignored, failed) with the reason, and the tries of a failed one. One row a message, so reading it again changes nothing.

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Bounce reported by the edge relay

field.name: ownerPartyId
field.description: If applicable, such as for customer records, the other Party that 'owns' the data for this Party.

field.name: privateOwnerUserId
field.description: For a personal contact, the user it belongs to: only that user sees the party (the MANTLE_USER_ORG and MANTLE_ACTIVE_ORG entity filters, and the party finds, searches, lookups and duplicate services). Empty for a directory party; cleared when the contact is linked to the directory.

field.name: storedValue
field.description: For RFID this is the unique tracking identifier (the TID can be tracked in the serialNumber field)

entity.description: A party's consent, granted or withdrawn, for a purpose (marketing email, SMS, phone, data processing): for one of its addresses (contactMechId) or the party as a whole (none), and for a list subscription change (contactListId), with when, how (sourceEnumId), the evidence and who recorded it. History only: each change is a new row and rows are not updated. The current state of a purpose for an address (or for the party, with no contactMechId) is its latest row without a contactListId, by consentDate; a row with a contactListId is the history of that list's subscription, whose state is the ContactListParty status. Whether an address may be solicited is PartyContactMech.allowSolicitation, which mantle.party.ConsentServices.store#PartyConsent keeps in step with the marketing purposes of the address.

field.name: evidenceText
field.description: What shows the consent or its withdrawal: the form and its wording, the import file, the message whose link was used

field.name: contactListId
field.description: Set on a list subscription change

field.name: userId
field.description: The user who recorded it; empty for the anonymous unsubscribe page

field.name: organizationPartyId
field.description: The organization a grant or withdrawal of a purpose is for (impl-marketing P3, F9); empty is global, for every organization. A party's state of a purpose for an organization is its latest row of that organization unless its latest global row withdraws it: a scoped grant never undoes a global withdrawal (mantle.party.ConsentServices get#PartyConsentState). A list's row needs none: the list's owner is its organization.

field.name: originalPartyContentId
field.description: Set this when copying content from one Party to another, may have same or different contentLocation

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Economic Operator Registration and Identification Code - EORI Number
Registration Number of the Professional Roll

entity.description: A decision that two parties are not duplicates (mantle.party.DuplicateServices mark#PartyNotDuplicate and unmark#PartyNotDuplicate). The duplicate services leave the pair out: find#PartyDuplicates, find#PartyHasDuplicates, find#PartyNameMatches and so the check#AllPartyDuplicates scan. One row per pair either way round: partyId is the lower id of the two and otherPartyId the higher, so a party's decisions are the rows with its id in either field. merge#Parties moves the merged party's decisions to the party it is merged into.

field.name: relationshipName
field.description: Official name of relationship, such as title in an organization.

relationship.description: This is one-nofk because settingValue may by an enumId or may be plain text depending on PartySettingType
This is one-nofk because settingValue may by an enumId or may be plain text depending on PartySettingType

field.name: validRegexp
field.description: For non-enum settings, regexp to validate
